focus.name: player-response-cleanup-family
focus.purpose: Promote the Type-0x23 response-pair activation and Type-0x5C/0x5D matching-actor cleanup prefixes to behavior-based canonical names.

shared_helper.name: PlayerCollision_ClearMatchingActorTypeRecords
shared_helper.contract: scan common actor records 1 through 24 using stride 0x42, clear records matching D7, release their resources, and enter PlayerCollision_ReinitializeResponseActor

contracts.type23: when PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is nonzero, pass the current actor to ActorCollision_SpawnType23ResponsePair at 0x001ABFFA
contracts.type5c: select cleanup type 0x08 and enter the shared matching-record sweep
contracts.type5d: select cleanup type 0x09 and enter the shared matching-record sweep
